about:
Restaurant City Providence operates a restaurant equipment and supply showroom in Providence, Rhode Island. The location is part of a company that cites over 100 years of combined industry experience, though a specific founding date for this branch is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided.

The company functions as a distributor and reseller of commercial kitchen equipment, providing products ranging from cooking and refrigeration units to smallwares and tabletop supplies. It offers financing options and operates a "Kitchen Campus" for design consultation and product demonstration. Staff specialists assist with equipment selection and quote preparation. Facility size, employee count, and sales volumes are not disclosed.

Its customers include independent restaurants, institutional foodservice operators, and hospitality businesses throughout the New England region. The showroom caters to both new venue build-outs and equipment replacement needs.

The company emphasizes its depth of industry knowledge, citing more than a century of collective experience among its staff, and promotes tailored equipment quotes delivered quickly. It positions its specialist consultation and financing programs as key differentiators for foodservice operators navigating equipment purchases.
